currentTargetEvidenceQuery.finding: getAiRoutingTargetEvidenceForItem selects item id/readableId/name/description/notes plus the latest Succeeded aiDrawingExtraction object; it does not join material, methodMaterial, makeMethod material inputs, or BOM/raw-material rows.

targetEvidenceMapper.finding: aiRoutingTargetEvidenceFromExtractionRow maps only the selected item fields and normalized drawing extraction into aiRoutingTargetEvidenceFromDrawing.

targetEvidenceShape.finding: AiRoutingTargetEvidence contains readableId/name, materialTags, featureTags, optional processHints/drawingEvidence/warnings. Raw-material leaf rows, component codes, operationSequence, and route operations are not part of target evidence.

drawingLaserHints.finding: drawingProcessHints derives 激光切割 from sheet-like or explicit laser drawing text unless explicit negative laser-unsuitable text exists. It does not consume U8 raw-material/BOM rows.

existingTests.finding: Tests cover explicit laser-unsuitable/suitable drawing evidence and verify PDF-only target evidence does not expose target operations/processTags.

comparatorEvidence.phase1Decision: No route-generation change and no target-evidence adapter implementation yet.

BOM operationSequence 0020: 1000/1000 positive parts vs 1180/1182 controls; not discriminative.
采购 + 板材/平板 + 0020 still appears in controls; not sufficient alone.

SUS304/SUS316 2B平板, 拉丝板, and 定尺不锈钢毛坯 overlap positive and control sets.
priorSourceAuditFacts: Method raw-material rows exist for 1927930206, 192769010102, and 1927930202.
Structured direct/material raw-material properties are not populated for these target rows.
No explicit positive/negative laser suitability field or text exists in current structured target evidence.

allowedNow: Item master fields currently selected by getAiRoutingTargetEvidenceForItem: readableId/readableIdWithRevision/name/description/notes.
Latest Succeeded aiDrawingExtraction when it is tied to the target item/document and normalized as drawing evidence.
Explicit drawing text saying raw stock is suitable or not suitable for laser cutting.
candidateButNotImplemented: Direct item material table fields, if populated and independently maintained as item/master-data properties rather than route-derived truth.

Independent U8/BOM recursive leaf raw-material import, only if exposed without route operations/XJG flags/truth route labels and paired with explicit suitability evidence or an approved curated stock-class mapping.
Curated raw-material/stock laser-suitability mapping, only after approval plus RED/GREEN tests and 30-holdout verification.
forbiddenOrLeaky: Active U8 route operations, XJG/XJG01/激光/切割 flags, or truth route operation sequence for the target.
Locked Evaluation truth routes, target processTags, target operations, work centers, or sample-role labels.
Active makeMethod/methodOperation route data as target evidence when it is the answer route being predicted.
BOM operationSequence such as 0020 as a laser rule, because Phase 1 proved it appears in no-laser controls and may be route-operation aligned.
ambiguous: methodMaterial rows under an active makeMethod: useful for audit, but unsafe as generation input until classified as pre-route BOM evidence or separated from answer-route makeMethod truth.
Raw-material free text such as 毛坯, 拉丝板, 平板, 6061, SUS304/SUS316: useful for review, not sufficient as a direct add/suppress rule without explicit suitability or approved mapping.

decision.reason: The current AI Routing target evidence path has no non-leaking raw-material/BOM evidence source beyond item fields and drawing extraction. Prior audits found raw-material names but no populated structured laser-suitability field, and Phase 1 proved raw category/text/operationSequence overlap is too high for direct rules. Implementing an adapter now would either add non-discriminative evidence or risk leaking the active route truth.
decision.stopCondition: Stop before code changes; do not proceed to Phase 3 RED implementation until explicit non-leaking suitability evidence or an approved curated mapping exists.

required: Define/import a target-available raw-material/stock suitability source that is independent of active route operations and Evaluation truth.
Classify each source column as allowed, ambiguous, or forbidden before adapter implementation.

Only then write RED tests: preserve 1927930202 laser, suppress 1927930206/192769010102 only from explicit evidence, preserve 192759010202 role disambiguation, and block raw text/category/0020-only rules.
Run focused AI Routing tests and 30-holdout verification before any production route-generation change.
blocked: No adapter based on raw-material free text alone.
No rule based on 板材/平板, 拉丝板, 毛坯/6061, or 0020 alone.
